capabilities: Switch a note's display between original, English and German
Translate sentences via an OpenAI-compatible LLM and cache them in the vault
Edit translated sentences and restore replaced originals
Maintain a scoped glossary that corrects recurring term translations
Bulk-translate a folder with a token and cost estimate
disambiguation: Not a file-rewriting translator: switching languages only renders a translation over the note, and only between English and German.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later for secret storage. Mobile is view-only: it reads pre-generated translations from the synced cache folder and never calls an API. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read mixed German and English notes in one language; editing the file to translate it would break search, backlinks and sync.

relations.evidence: Built on the official Obsidian sample plugin template and API.

requires.name: Cloud provider account (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Meta Model API)

summary: Display-only translator that switches a note's view between its original text, English and German using any OpenAI-compatible LLM, without rewriting files.
